mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: Caelan! That dreadful wheel’s finally stopped altogether.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: You said it was making a noise.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: And now it isn’t making any noise. That’s worse!

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Did you ask Mira to look at it?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: That’s why I’m here. I could use her help—and another pair of hands, if you can spare him.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: There are kitchens waiting on that flour. I’d rather they didn’t all come asking me about it at once.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Mira should be at her workbench, outside the workshop before the upper bridge.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: I’ll stop there on my way to the mill.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: And be careful along the channel. Both of you.
